description: White immediately challenges Black's d5 pawn with c4, aiming for the strategically rich isolated-queen's-pawn positions that define the Panov-Botvinnik. Black develops actively with ...Nf6 and the ...Bb4 pin — the most instructive Caro-Kann line for understanding IQP strategy.

lines.description: After 1.e4 c6 2.d4 d5, White trades 3.exd5 cxd5 and immediately challenges with 4.c4, the Panov-Botvinnik. Black develops 4...Nf6 and after 5.Nc3 e6 White continues 6.Nf3, when Black pins with 6...Bb4. The resulting isolated queen's pawn positions are a complete strategic education: White plays for the d5 break and piece activity, Black blockades on d5 and targets the pawn in the endgame.
lines.name: Caro-Kann — Panov-Botvinnik Attack
